rule_quote: Under `immutable-binding-exclusive-loan` (owner ruling, 2026-11-12), modifying an established ordinary local's owned storage requires a `mut` binding. This covers direct assignment, writes to owned fields or array elements, and formation of `&mut` or `&write` loans to those places. A callee cannot grant writable access that the caller's place lacks. Initialization remains subject to the ordinary establishment rules.
